Can it arrive gift-ready, and how fast can it ship?

It can work well as a gift - our standard shipments do not include a packing slip with item prices or the order number. For timing, orders are processed on business days, Monday through Friday, excluding holidays, and orders placed after 12 PM EST start processing the next business day. Shipping speed depends on the option shown at checkout. If you share the delivery ZIP, I can help you narrow down the best option. 🖤

If they want to exchange it, how would that work?

Yes, for gifts purchased on SPANX.com, they can start a return or exchange through our online portal here: Return or Exchange.

For the same style, they can exchange for a different size, inseam, or color. For a completely different style, they’d return it and place a new order. Let me know if there’s anything more I can assist with.

Any discount if I add a second smaller item?

There isn’t an extra discount just for adding a second smaller item. If there’s a site promotion, like a category offer, it will apply automatically to eligible items in your cart. You can also use one discount code at checkout, such as a welcome offer or Icon Rewards code, but codes can’t be combined.

If you want, tell me which second item you’re considering and I’ll help you pick the best value option. 🖤
